args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (unhealthy, error rate 18% in us-east, us-west, eu-west). The release candidate v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified in all three regions. Next steps: confirm health checks recover, and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. It's now running in all three regions, the service reports healthy, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened INC-0001 (SEV2) for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It says what failed and what I did. Next steps listed there are to watch the health checks and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying it.

The rollback went back to a version that had already been healthy in production, so it didn't need change-manager approval.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
